InputFusion 0.4.1, unmodified x64 XInput release library
Bundled as BlurInputFusion.dll; loaded explicitly by Rebuilt's input backend.

Upstream: https://github.com/xan105/InputFusion
Source: https://github.com/xan105/InputFusion/tree/e3e6e7f97f8e7b3927a09a4649c2ec3bef9ef956
Release: https://github.com/xan105/InputFusion/releases/tag/0.4.1
DLL SHA256: 242e16a3a5904eb9068bd442c6a466fd983dbbe7851022704985dce3fb6ec408

InputFusion is licensed under LGPL-3.0; see LGPL-3.0.txt and GPL-3.0.txt.
Its vendored SDL and Detours notices are included from the same source commit.
The exact source tree includes the library and its vendored dependencies.
No InputFusion code was modified for this integration.

The library remains a separate runtime DLL and can be replaced independently
of Amax.exe. BLUR_INPUT_BACKEND=system uses Windows XInput instead.
